say:2:1230516001:1.text: You have no idea how much the Carmine Whispers despise us!
say:2:1230516001:1.source_cn: 你是不知道血薇帮有多瞧不起我们！
say:2:1230516001:1.male: You have no idea how much the Carmine Whispers despise us!
say:2:1230516001:1.female: You have no idea how much the Carmine Whispers despise us!

say:3:1230516002:1.text: Most of the new recruits for the Water Wights are dockworkers.
say:3:1230516002:1.source_cn: 水鬼帮里新加入的，大多都是码头工人。
say:3:1230516002:1.male: Most of the new recruits for the Water Wights are dockworkers.
say:3:1230516002:1.female: Most of the new recruits for the Water Wights are dockworkers.
